order._instruction: Execution order in the pipeline (optional for standalone operations)

operation_type._instruction: Kind of operation to perform (e.g., subsample, projection, convolution).

input_mapping._instruction: Maps function arguments to pipeline data/outputs

output_alias._instruction: Optional name for this step's output (default: function name)

apply_on_dimension._instruction: Which dimension to apply function on (e.g., 'time', 'space')
